CFML Language Reference: Functions

LSParseNumber

Reads a number written in the conventions of the current locale and returns it as a number. Leading and trailing spaces are ignored.

Category

International functions

Syntax

LSParseNumber(string)

Parameters

string
The string to convert, for example "1234.5".

Returns

The number.

Usage

If the string is not a number, the function throws an error; test it with LSIsNumeric first. KoldFusion formats every locale with the English (US) conventions (see SetLocale); thousands separators such as "1,234.5" are accepted. Unlike Val, which quietly returns 0 for text it cannot read, LSParseNumber insists on a real number.

Example

Opens the example in a new window. The example runs on this server, so it only works when you browse from the server itself (127.0.0.1).
<CFSET Tests = "1234.5| 42 |-0.001|1,999,999">
<TABLE BORDER=1 CELLPADDING=3>
<TR><TH>String</TH><TH>Number</TH><TH>Times two</TH></TR>
<CFLOOP INDEX="S" LIST="#Tests#" DELIMITERS="|">
<CFSET N = LSParseNumber(Replace(S, ",", "", "ALL"))>
<CFOUTPUT>
<TR><TD>[#S#]</TD><TD>#N#</TD><TD>#N * 2#</TD></TR>
</CFOUTPUT>
</CFLOOP>
</TABLE>
